run_twist_generation: run the TWIST model to generate audio from an input speech prompt file
run_full_generation_function: run the run_full_generation function to encode, generate, and vocode speech from a prompt
build_speech_encoder: build a SpeechEncoder with mhubert-base-25hz and kmeans quantizer for speech unit extraction
build_hifi_vocoder: build a CodeHiFiGANVocoder to decode generated speech units back into audio waveforms
generate_with_offset: generate continuation audio tokens from a speech prompt using the TWIST language model
